messages.text:
Our records show the Bluetooth speaker was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). We can’t send the refund to your sister’s account; refunds can only go to the order’s original payment (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The speaker is eligible for a refund of BRL 149.65 to the original payment. Would you like me to request that instead? (refund-policy/v2/amount)

messages.text: No, I don’t want the refund sent to the original payment. My sister has my permission to receive it.

I understand, but your permission doesn’t change where the refund can go: it can only be paid to the order’s original payment, not your sister’s account (refund-policy/v2/payment). Since you don’t want it sent there, I won’t request the refund.
